scope: Three source root causes; no generated output edits, suppressions, or dependency changes.

rootCauses.name: Iframe hydration initialization
rootCauses.impact: Browser-derived sandbox attributes could differ from the server if an iframe is immediately visible. The normal default lazy-loading path usually masks this; no production hydration failure was observed.
rootCauses.fix: useSyncExternalStore with an explicit undefined server snapshot; defer src until both visibility and parent origin are known, preserving lazy loading and applying provider permissions before navigation. Origin subscription is intentionally inert because origin changes replace the document.
rootCauses.tests: Server-render and hydrate with both initially visible and initially hidden observer states. Same iframe DOM node retained, no hydration errors, src deferred, existing sizing/fullscreen/feature permissions/provider sandbox preserved.

rootCauses.name: List pagination delayed scroll ownership
rootCauses.impact: An old pagination timer can scroll after a newer page selection or after unmount. Route event cleanup already existed but did not cancel the timer.
rootCauses.fix: Store timeout handle and cancel it in the same cleanup that unsubscribes the route listener. Preserve the one-second smooth-scroll delay for the current page.
rootCauses.tests: Regression failed before fix due to stale scroll. Passes after: rapid page changes cancel older timers, newest page scrolls once at one second, unmount cancels pending work and removes route listener. Existing pagination/search data-fetch test also passes.

rootCauses.name: Menu deferred-open timer ownership
rootCauses.impact: Queued opening can run after initialOpen becomes false or after unmount, opening an unwanted menu or acting on stale component state.
rootCauses.fix: Return timeout cancellation from the effect; explicit undefined when no timer was scheduled.
rootCauses.tests: Regression failed before fix because menu opened after initialOpen=false. Passes after, including normal deferred opening and zero pending timers after Strict Mode unmount.

recipeReview: Hydration fetched with no-cache curl this pass; previously fetched cleanup recipe re-used. Explicit stable server snapshot and exact timer cleanup recipes followed.
grouping: No fixGroupId on the three selected diagnostics. Each has its own independent resource/initialization lifecycle.

validation.unitTests: 19 passed across 5 files; menu test rerun after strict-return correction also passes
validation.browserTests: 5 existing Chromium sandbox/GTM integration tests pass
validation.eslint: Zero errors; 9 pre-existing ref-in-render and state-in-effect warnings in list/menu code remain untouched
validation.build: No production rebuild this pass; SSR/hydration, unit, browser behavior, and full typecheck verified without changing generated artifacts.

followUp: useExternalScript intentionally retains a one-shot status recorder after unmount so late script loads are remembered. Review persistent ownership before changing it; do not blindly remove listeners.
Remaining key/accessibility, nested-component, fetch-status, state, and complexity findings left for later.
